notes: Selected by referraleasy_guardrails.evaluation: the lowest threshold whose benign-block rate on the calibration partition (11 cases) stays inside the 5% budget. The score is a cosine similarity to the closest attack reference, not a calibrated probability, and the layer's block rule additionally requires that reference to be the closest one of all. This record is for the offline lexical rung; the pinned ADR-0005 encoder's threshold remains UNMEASURED in this environment (the 23 MB artifact is not present), and `mismatch()` refuses to apply a record to a different method.

measured_latency_ms.method: per-call wall clock around score() on this machine
